_paths: The contract carries both a coordination path and a refusal path. AUTHORIZED: the independent observer quorum (threshold 2, observer_set resolution_oracles) accepts resolution_evidence, the coordination reaches QUORUM_MET and closes at CLOSED (terminalKind success). REFUSAL: quorum is not reached before the PT24H timeout, so the attestation fallback 'escalate' drives TIMEOUT -> ESCALATE and the coordination ends at ESCALATED (terminalKind contested). This file pins the AUTHORIZED path, because the v0.5.0 scenario format encodes exactly one execution per scenario and  forbids a second one; the refusal path is a declared, reachable terminal of the same contract rather than an absent case.
